$comment: Morale (ruleset v0; spec S2 section 7, settled 2026-11-07; numbers are proposals). Per regiment, 0 to start, updated at 4 Hz; every loss is multiplied by the unit type's moraleShockPermille. Own losses cost lost x ownLossFactor / starting size; a friendly regiment's losses within nearMm cost count x nearbyLossFactor / own starting size (at most nearbyLossCap; half that out to farMm); a friend routing within nearMm costs friendRoutingPerS, one wiped friendWipedOnce; an enemy routing gives enemyRoutingPerS; after recoveryQuietTicks without a loss morale recovers recoveryPerS up to 1,000 less the losses so far in permille. Routs below routBelow; rallies once (D3) after safeTicks with no enemy within noEnemyWithinMm and awayFromLethalMm from lethal ground, at moraleAfter; a second rout is final. A regiment is wiped below wipedBelowPermille of its starting size (brief 2026-10-09: about 10%). The distance-to-lethal field is capped at 50 m, so the rally's awayFromLethalMm reads as "at the cap" until the field reaches further.
